task_completion.description: Navigate to the Online Assessment module in Eramba.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Eramba sidebar or header shows 'Online Assessment' or 'Questionnaires' as the active module.

task_completion.description: Create a new assessment titled 'Vendor Security Assessment - Tier 1'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or list view showing the title 'Vendor Security Assessment - Tier 1' entered into the name/title field.

task_completion.description: Add a chapter named 'General Security Controls' to the assessment.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A chapter or section header within the questionnaire builder labeled 'General Security Controls'.

task_completion.description: Add the 'ISO 27001 Certification' question with Yes/No type.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A question field showing the text 'ISO 27001 Certification' and a selected response type of 'Yes/No' or 'Boolean'.

task_completion.description: Add the 'Data Encryption Standards' question with Text/Long Text type.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A question field showing the text 'Data Encryption Standards' and a selected response type of 'Text' or 'Long Text'.

task_completion.description: Add the 'Security Policy Evidence' question with Attachment/File Upload type.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A question field showing the text 'Security Policy Evidence' and a selected response type of 'Attachment' or 'File Upload'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Eramba web interface rather than API calls or terminal scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with Eramba UI elements and form fields being filled.

integrity.description: The agent did not leave the question types as default if they didn't match the requirements.
integrity.visual_evidence: Dropdown menus for question types are seen being clicked and specific types (Yes/No, Text, Attachment) selected.

integrity.description: The questionnaire was created during the session, not just viewing an existing one.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Add' or 'New' button is clicked, and empty fields are populated with the required text.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The assessment must be titled 'Vendor Security Assessment - Tier 1'. It must contain one chapter named 'General Security Controls'. Inside that chapter, there must be three specific questions: 1. 'ISO 27001 Certification' (Type: Yes/No), 2. 'Data Encryption Standards' (Type: Text or Long Text), and 3. 'Security Policy Evidence' (Type: Attachment or File Upload). Eramba typically uses a builder interface where chapters are created first, then questions are nested within them.
